@graph.description: Groundwater is a vital component of the global supply of freshwater, playing a critical role for human populations, agriculture, and ecosystems. Due to the complex interactions between groundwater, surface water, climate, and human activity, these systems are frequently studied using advanced data analysis and modeling techniques. The effectiveness of these methods is generally enhanced by the availability and quality of data. In Switzerland, the focus area of this study, groundwater data is fragmented and lacks a standardized nationwide compilation. Consequently, the process of conducting nationwide studies with substantial sample sizes is both resourceintensive and time-consuming. In this paper we introduce the Swiss Groundwater Database, a comprehensive compilation of groundwater time series and associated metadata throughout Switzerland. The current database consists of groundwater level data from 985 monitoring wells, which were completed with additional static and time-varying variables. The environmental characteristics and climate indices were compiled and determined for each monitoring well. The database is designed to facilitate and support large-sample hydrological research related to groundwater in Switzerland and beyond.

@graph.description:
Data related to the manuscript under consideration in Scientific data titled "A national-scale database of groundwater level data for Switzerland".

Raoul A. Collenteur (raoul.collenteur@hydroconsult.ch) and Christian Moeck (christian.moeck@eawag.ch).

General Information-------------------

This repository contains the data of the Swiss Groundwater Database, consisting of nearly 1000 groundwater level time series from all over Switzerland. These data are augmented with meteorological data and environmental descriptors. The authors (listed above) appreciate being informed about usage of the data to keep track of its usage, and welcome collaboration to further enhance the database in the future. We recommend using the data in 0_data/final for subsequent analyses. For analyses requiring gap-filled groundwater time series, the groundwater level data from the folder "0_data/imputation" can be used.

File structure--------------

- 0_data/--- final => final Swiss Groundwater Database. USE THIS DATA FOR ANALYSES--- raw => raw data received from the data providers--- processed => processed data--- gis => all the GIS data used--- imputation => gapless time series, imputed time series are provided for the period 1980-2023- 1_scripts => all the scripts to process the data.- 2_figures => Figures produced by the scripts for the paper--- ts => figures of all the time series--- imputed => summary figures for the imputation
